$comment: Files consumers may vendor under vendor/pawprint/. Bicep has no module registry available here, so sharing means copying; this manifest is what makes the copy auditable rather than folklore. kit-bicep-validate.yml fails a consumer build when a vendored copy drifts from these sources.

files.description: Resolves config/deploy.config.json into deployment environment variables.
Fails on malformed deployment variables before any Azure call is made.
Reports expired, expiring and unexpiring Key Vault secrets.
Static Web App with an optional DNS-validated custom domain.
RBAC-authorised Key Vault serving either secret tier.
Per-secret read grants, for consumers on the platform secret tier.
